en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a large historic building complex with an ornate façade and a tall clock/bell tower on a city square. The building has Baroque and eclectic architectural details and houses street-level shops. In the upper left corner the printed word "Városház." appears, and in the upper right corner "Pécs." The reverse side shows handwritten Hungarian text, a green Hungarian postage stamp, postmarks, and the printed heading "LEVELEZŐ LAP" along with a publisher line at the bottom.
